ValidationRule.description: On vehicles published from Odoo, the fields Odoo owns can only be changed in Odoo. Branch, images, notes, default terms and suggested downpayment stay editable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.Odoo_Integration), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Odoo_Vehicle_ID__c))), ISCHANGED(Odoo_Vehicle_ID__c) ), OR( ISCHANGED(Odoo_Vehicle_ID__c), ISCHANGED(VIN__c), ISCHANGED(Vehicle_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Brand__c), ISCHANGED(Model__c), ISCHANGED(Year__c), ISCHANGED(Condition__c), ISCHANGED(Odometer__c), ISCHANGED(Plate_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Color__c), ISCHANGED(Selling_Price__c), ISCHANGED(Selling_Price_PHP__c), ISCHANGED(Inventory_Status__c), ISCHANGED(Available_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Listing_URL__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This vehicle is managed in Odoo. Change its VIN, specs, price or status in the Odoo Vehicle Master; the update syncs here automatically.
